entities.summary: Rumen Aleksandrov is a Bulgarian weightlifter. He won the silver medal in the 90 Kg class in the 1980 Summer Olympics in Moscow. He was champion of Europe in 1980, in Belgrade, Serbia. Aleksandrov was also world and European junior champion in 1978 in Athens, Greece.
